# funnel_custom_dimension (Data Source)

Reads an existing custom dimension. Use it to copy a dimension, including rules built in the Funnel UI, to another workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copy a dimension built in the Funnel UI from one workspace to another
data "funnel_custom_dimension" "source" {
  workspace = var.source_workspace_id
  id        = var.source_dimension_id
}

resource "funnel_custom_dimension" "copy" {
  workspace   = var.target_workspace_id
  name        = data.funnel_custom_dimension.source.name
  description = data.funnel_custom_dimension.source.description
  unit        = data.funnel_custom_dimension.source.unit
  derived     = data.funnel_custom_dimension.source.derived
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Custom dimension ID
- `workspace` (String) Funnel workspace ID the custom dimension belongs to

### Read-Only

- `derived` (String) JSON-encoded rules for how the dimension is calculated. Null if the dimension has no rules.
- `description` (String) Custom dimension description
- `name` (String) Custom dimension name
- `unit` (String) Custom dimension unit type
